slug: 2025-06-18 Benin envisages mobile wallet launch in inclusive national digital ID push

systems.tiers: national; nearly 98% of the population registered, more than 10 million identity documents issued, close to 200,000 biometric authentications a day, connected to more than 80 public and private institutions (ANIP's director general, ID4Africa, May 2025)

note: ANIP's director general says birth registration and identity management sit under one body and that a law gave legal identity to people without birth certificates; the document describes no system by which births or deaths are recorded.
